caption:
The trip from Salvador to Morro de São Paulo is easier when you know what each stretch looks like.

A pick-up by air-conditioned van, a ferry across the bay, another van along the coast, and a fast boat for the last few minutes. We walk you through it step by step, from the pick-up to the pier, plus a few things worth knowing before you land.

Send us your arrival date and we'll help you choose how to get here.
